appDescription.message: Finds deals from your employee benefits portal for the site you're on. Unofficial – not affiliated with corporate benefits Germany GmbH.

popupFiguresAsOf.message: Figures as of $DATE$ · portal page is authoritative

popupNoMatchBody.message: No offer in your catalogue matches this site. Search by hand if you expected one.

popupNoPortalHeading.message: Tell it where your portal lives

popupNoPortalBody.message: Every employer has its own address. Set it once, and the badge starts counting deals on the sites you visit.

popupNoPermissionBody.message: The extension may only read the one domain you approve. Nothing wider is requested.

popupNotLoggedInHeading.message: Sign in to your portal to see deals

popupNotLoggedInBody.message: Deals are read with the login you already hold in this browser — no password is ever stored here.

popupNotApplicable.message: No deals to find for this page.

popupDefaultHint.message: Open a website to find deals for it.

popupErrorNotice.message: Something went wrong checking your portal: $ERROR$

popupManualErrNotLoggedIn.message: You're not logged in to your CB portal.

popupManualErrNoPortal.message: Set up your CB portal URL in settings first.

popupAutoOnTitle.message: Alert automatically on this site again

popupAutoSessionTitle.message: Off for this site until the browser is closed

popupAutoAlwaysTitle.message: Off for this site for good

popupAutoStateSession.message: Off here until the browser closes

optionsPanelNote.message: The catalogue downloads once a week; every match after that is decided on your machine. That is why a heavy browsing day costs the portal nothing.

optionsPortalRowDesc.message: Set once per install. Approving grants access to that one domain — nothing wider.

optionsStatusInvalid.message: Please enter a valid portal address.

optionsStatusNotGranted.message: Access wasn't granted, so the extension can't reach your portal yet.

optionsAutoScanRowDesc.message: Reads only each page's title, so the badge is right without opening the popup. Needs the broad all-sites permission.

optionsAutoScanOnDesc.message: Deals are found on every site you visit.

optionsAutoScanOffDesc.message: Open the popup manually to look for deals.

optionsNotifyRowDesc.message: Fires once per page, and only while automatic finding is on.

optionsNotifySilentDesc.message: The toolbar icon carries a count. Nothing else happens.

optionsNotifyNotificationDesc.message: A system notification naming the deal; clicking it switches to that tab.

optionsNotifyPopupDesc.message: Chrome permits this only in some situations — otherwise it falls back to a notification.

optionsMutedRowDesc.message: Set per site in the popup. The badge still counts there — only the automatic alert stops.

optionsCatalogRowDesc.message: Brand names are stable; discount amounts are not. Refresh if a figure looks wrong.

optionsCatalogMeta.message: Updated $AGE$ ago · next automatic sync in $NEXT$

optionsCatalogNone.message: No catalogue yet — it will be downloaded on your next browsing session.

optionsCatalogErrNotLoggedIn.message: Not logged in to your portal — log in there first.

optionsHowRowDesc.message: Kept in full, out of the way of the controls.

optionsHowLi1.message: You must already be logged in to your CB portal in this browser — the extension reuses that session and never sees or stores your password.

optionsHowLi2.message: When you visit a site, the extension guesses a brand name from its domain and matches it against the local catalogue.

optionsHowLi3.message: Nothing is sent anywhere except requests to the portal origin you approve here.

setupHeading.message: Where do you log in for employee deals?

setupLede.message: Every employer has its own portal address. Paste yours and approve the prompt — that grants access to this one domain, nothing wider. Your password never touches the extension.

setupStep1Desc.message: Approve access to that one domain.

setupStep2Desc.message: In a normal tab, as you always do.

setupStep3Desc.message: The badge counts deals on the site you're on.

setupFootnote.message: Unofficial · not affiliated with, operated by or endorsed by corporate benefits Germany GmbH.

notifyOneDeal.message: An offer waits on your portal for the site you're reading.

notifyMultipleDeals.message: $COUNT$ offers wait on your portal for the site you're reading.

disclaimerAffiliation.message: This is a private, unofficial tool. It is not affiliated with, operated by, endorsed by, or reviewed by corporate benefits Germany GmbH. All brand names, product names and logos belong to their respective owners.

disclaimerServerLoad.message: The offer catalogue is deliberately downloaded only once a week – staggered rather than in one burst – and all matching afterwards happens locally in your browser. This is done explicitly to keep load on corporate benefits' servers as low as possible: instead of a search request on every page you visit, only a handful of requests are made per week.

disclaimerAccuracy.message: Discount figures come from the locally cached catalogue and may be out of date. Only the offer page on the portal itself is authoritative. No warranty, no liability.

disclaimerConfidential.message: The offers and discount codes are subject to your portal's terms of use and are confidential. They are intended for eligible employees only and must not be shared with third parties or published.
